title: Skills optimization flight — skills/objectstack-i18n: DIET (≈ −1,685 tok, −27%) — "Core Concepts" restated in full four sections later, a per-namespace layout with zero real usages, `os i18n check` taught in six places, and the #1 real pattern (a package shipping its own generated bundle) dead-ends
body:
Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`). Read-only audit at objectstack `origin/main` a59f78d. Full findings table = audit record: the dev posts `audit/objectstack-i18n/findings.md` (seat scratchpad) verbatim as the first comment at claim time.

## Audit summary

3 files, 7,296 tok shipped: `SKILL.md` 6,337 (headroom 1) · `evals/README.md` 410 (headroom 1) · generated 549. Real usage: 6 patterns — object/field labels + `pluralLabel` (3 apps, 40/37 sites), option label maps (23), `_sections` (10), `_views` + `emptyState` (12/2), `apps`/`navigation`/`messages` (6/3/5), stack registration (3) — and the biggest by far, **a package shipping its own generated bundle** (8 packages, 36 `*.objects.generated.ts` across 4 locales, 11 `withSourceFallback` sites, 5 `kernel:ready` `loadTranslations` sites), which is the package's main hole. Enumeration check: 12 of 14 presented-as-exhaustive enumerations complete; two stale (`_tabs` missing from the lint-surface list `:300-302`; `--objects-only` missing from the extract flag list `:546-547`). Retired-spelling residue: none. Verdict **DIET** (28.8%).

## Hazards short of falsehood (fix in this flight)

1. `SKILL.md:513` — `kernel.use(new I18nServicePlugin({…}))` is not awaited; `ObjectKernel.use` is async (`packages/core/src/kernel.ts:192`); platform's own examples write `await kernel.use(...)`.
2. `SKILL.md:535-560` — the extract → translate → check workflow cannot converge: extract defaults to `--objects-only` while `os i18n check` demands `app`/`navigation`/`dashboard`/… keys (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts:190-220`). One clause naming `--objects-only` makes it terminate.

## Three funded additions

1. Canonical "package ships its own generated bundle" block (+180, paid by I18N-D-01 + I18N-D-05) — the real shape: `const enSource: TranslationData = { objects: enObjects }` → `withSourceFallback({objects: zhCNObjects}, enSource, undefined, zhCNGeneratedSourceHashes)` (public `@objectstack/platform-objects/apps`) → `i18n.loadTranslations` at `kernel:ready`; fold `--source-hashes`' purpose in (I18N-F-04).
2. One clause naming `--objects-only` (+25, paid by I18N-B-03).
3. `translation` metadata item in the frontmatter description (+12) and "tab, " in the lint-surface list (+3), paid by I18N-A-01.

## Flight scope

**IMPLEMENT** (same-file, shrink-only): every row above and in the findings file at HIGH or MED except the deferred ones; the two stale enumerations; the two hazards; the three funded additions; the description edits (regenerate the README index only if the drift gate requires it — report which).

**ANCHOR RULINGS**: plugin wiring / `os serve` auto-registration → objectstack-platform (I18N-C-01: delete + pointer). Field/view labels stay here (data and ui point here for translation of what they declare).

**DEFER**: I18N-H-01 (eval stub, #14296 item 2); I18N-C-03 (generator-owned `_index.md` transitive pointers → out-of-scope card for the spec lane's `build-skill-references.ts`); I18N-A-03 (a routing bullet in `skills/README.md` → "follow-up for skills/README.md" in the PR body).

## Flight constraints (binding)

- ONE draft PR, first line `Fixes #<this card>`; governed ⇒ stays draft; review requests are the seat's step.
- Token ratchet: `SKILL.md` may not grow; additions paid by deletions in the same file; ⛔ re-wrap is not payment; ⛔ no ceiling raise; ⛔ no new files; ⛔ do not touch the ratchet script.
- ⛔ Never edit another package's files; follow-ups in the PR body. Generated files untouched.
- Live surface with zero measured usage ⇒ one row pointing at its schema; retired/tombstoned ⇒ delete. A false claim matching a spec `.describe()` string ⇒ spec-side twin card.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, plus `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands <changed paths>`; record the head sha.
- PR body: per-item 落点 | before | after keyed by finding id; per-file token delta; `needs:contract-review` on both carriers (the generated-bundle block and the `--objects-only` semantics are contract claims).

Refs: #14292 · #14296 · #13658.
